services.title: Business Tax Filing
services.text: Business returns including 1065 partnerships, 1120 S-Corp and C-Corp filings, prepared by tax professionals who work with small businesses all year.
services.lead: Partnerships, S-Corps and C-Corps each file differently. We prepare the return your entity actually owes and walk you through it.

covers.title: 1065 partnerships
covers.text: Partnership returns and the schedules that go with them.

covers.title: 1120 S-Corp
covers.text: S-Corp returns for owners who have moved out of filing as a sole proprietor.

covers.title: C-Corp
covers.text: Corporate returns prepared to IRS rules and guidelines.

services.title: Business Entity Formation
services.summary: Setting up the entity you file under.
services.text: Forming the entity your business files under, whether you are starting out or moving from self-employed into an LLC or a corporation.
services.lead: The entity you file under changes what you owe and what you are exposed to. We help you form the one that fits where the business is now.

services.title: Business Accounting and Payroll Setup
services.summary: Getting your books and payroll started.
services.text: Setting up the accounting and payroll your business runs on, so the records are in order before the filing deadline arrives.
services.lead: Accounting and payroll set up properly at the start saves the scramble later. Our accounting team gets the systems running and shows you how to keep them.

services.title: Bookkeeping
services.text: Bookkeeping for business clients, kept by our accounting team through the year. Call or write for more information on what it covers.
services.lead: Quality financial reporting gives you line of sight on business performance and profitability, so you can make data-driven decisions. Call the office for more information on our bookkeeping service.

services.title: Business Consulting
services.summary: Advice on how the business is performing.
services.text: Consulting for business owners who want line of sight on performance and profitability, backed by quality financial reporting.
services.lead: Our accounting manager consults with clients to give them line of sight regarding their business performance and profitability, so they can make data-driven business decisions.

services.title: Audit Assistance
services.summary: Help when the IRS comes back to you.
services.text: Help working through an IRS audit, from the first letter to the strategy for putting the matter behind you.
services.lead: An IRS letter is easier to answer with somebody who files returns every day sitting beside you. We help clients work through audits and the questions that come with them.

about.title: A tax firm built on relationships.
text: Hung Nguyen started HARN Financial Group in 2011 with the love and support of his family and friends, using his personal values to reach a professional goal: a company that differentiates itself by putting emphasis on building relationships and providing unparalleled service to the people of his community.
Our team strives to build relationships. We appreciate the trust our clients have granted us, which enables our professionals to deliver exceptional service, one client at a time.

We believe our clients value an educational and friendly tax filing experience anchored by face to face interactions. This inclusive approach provides an invaluable educational experience, of greater benefit than dropping off your paperwork.

faqs.q: How long should I hold on to my tax returns?
faqs.a: The IRS advises keeping copies of your prior-year returns for at least three years. If you change tax software for the coming filing season you will also need the adjusted gross income from your prior-year return to file electronically, because the Electronic Filing PIN is no longer an option.
